sender.name: Htoo Myat Kyaw
sender.role: Co-founder of Briefly · Product design and consulting

templates.name: Inquiry received
templates.when: Someone asks about hiring you. Send this first.
templates.subject: Got your message, {{first_name}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for reaching out about {{project}}. I read every message myself, and I'll send a proper reply by {{reply_by}}.
A few details would help me give you a useful answer:

list: What you're building, and who it's for
Where it stands today (an idea, a prototype, or a live product)
When you'd like to start, and any deadline
A rough budget range, if you have one

body: Reply to this email with whatever you have. Short notes are fine.

templates.name: Set up a call
templates.when: The project looks like a fit and you want to talk.
templates.subject: A quick call about {{project}}?
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for the details. This sounds like work I'd enjoy, and I think I can help.
The next step is a {{call_length}} call so I can understand the goal and you can ask me anything. These times work for me:

list: {{time_option_1}}
{{time_option_2}}
{{time_option_3}}

body: Pick one, or send a time that suits you better.
After the call I'll send a written scope and a quote.

templates.name: Scope and quote
templates.when: After the call, to put the offer in writing.
templates.subject: Scope and quote for {{project}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
It was good to talk. Here is what I'd do, how long it would take, and what it would cost.
**What I'll deliver**

list: {{deliverable_1}}
{{deliverable_2}}
{{deliverable_3}}

body: **Timeline:** {{timeline}}, starting {{start_date}}.
**Price:** {{price}}. {{payment_terms}}
**Not included:** {{out_of_scope}}
This quote is good until {{valid_until}}. If you'd like to change the scope, tell me and I'll revise it. To go ahead, reply with a yes.

templates.name: Project kickoff
templates.when: They said yes. Sets out what happens next.
templates.subject: We're on: {{project}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
I'm glad we're doing this. Here is how the first week will go.

list: **Discover:** I get to know your users, your product, and the problem worth solving.
**Define:** I turn that into one clear direction and a short list of priorities.
**Design:** I explore, test, and refine until it feels right.
**Deliver:** I hand it over ready to build, and stay close while it ships.

body: To start, I need these from you by {{needed_by}}:

list: {{need_1}}
{{need_2}}

body: I'll send an update every {{update_day}}. If something is unclear before then, email me.

templates.name: Follow-up
templates.when: No answer after a week or so.
templates.subject: Checking in on {{project}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
I wanted to check in on {{project}}. I sent {{what_you_sent}} on {{sent_date}} and haven't heard back.
If the timing has changed or you've gone another way, that's completely fine. A one-line reply is enough, so I know where things stand.
If you're still interested, I can hold a start date of {{start_date}} until {{hold_until}}.

templates.name: Not a fit
templates.subject: About {{project}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for thinking of me for {{project}}. I've looked at it carefully, and I can't take it on. {{reason}}
I'd rather tell you now than do a job I can't give my full attention to.
{{referral_line}}
I hope it goes well, and I'd be glad to hear how it turns out.

templates.name: Project wrap-up
templates.subject: {{project}} is delivered. Thank you.
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Everything for {{project}} is now with you: {{deliverables_link}}
Thank you for trusting me with it. I enjoyed {{specific_moment}}.
Two small requests, if you have a minute:

list: Tell me one thing I could have done better.
If the work helped, a sentence or two I can quote on my site would mean a lot.

body: If questions come up while you build, email me. I'm happy to help.

templates.name: Survey received
templates.when: A student filled in the admissions survey.
templates.subject: I got your answers, {{first_name}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for filling out the survey. I've read your answers, and I'll write back by {{reply_by}}.
A few things to know while you wait:

list: This help is free. I will never ask you for money.
Please don't send Social Security numbers or financial documents.
If you're under 18, you're welcome to include a parent, guardian, or counselor on our emails.

body: You've already done the hard part by asking. Talk soon.

templates.name: Next steps for a student
templates.when: Your real reply to a student, with what to do next.
templates.subject: Next steps for {{help_topic}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for your patience. You asked for help with {{help_topic}}, so here is where I'd start.

list: {{step_1}}
{{step_2}}
{{step_3}}

body: To give you better feedback, please send me {{what_to_send}}. A rough draft is fine. It doesn't need to be finished.
Your next deadline is {{deadline}}, so I'd aim to have this done by {{target_date}}.
This is one student's advice, and it isn't connected to Tufts Admissions or QuestBridge. Use what helps.

templates.name: At capacity
templates.when: You can't help a student right away.
templates.subject: About your admissions help request
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for reaching out. I'm helping as many students as I can right now, and I can't give your application the attention it deserves until {{available_date}}.
If your deadline is before then, please don't wait for me. Your school counselor and the QuestBridge website are good places to start today.
If {{available_date}} still works for you, reply to this email and I'll save you a spot.
I'm sorry I can't start sooner. I'm rooting for you.

templates.name: Podcaster, press, or partner
templates.when: Someone writes about working with Briefly.
templates.subject: Re: {{their_subject}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for getting in touch about {{topic}}.
Briefly is a short-form, audio-only podcast app. It finds the moments in an episode that are worth hearing and plays them as real clips, in the host's own voice, with a path back to the full episode.
{{your_answer}}
I'd be glad to talk it through. Does {{time_option}} work for a short call?

templates.name: Thanks for the feedback
templates.when: A listener sends feedback or a bug report.
templates.subject: Thank you for the feedback on Briefly
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for taking the time to write. Feedback like yours is how Briefly gets better.
You mentioned {{their_feedback}}. {{what_happens_next}}
We're a team of three, so every note gets read by a person. If you notice anything else, reply to this email.

templates.name: Quick acknowledgement
templates.when: You've seen an email and need time to answer.
templates.subject: Re: {{their_subject}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
I've received this, thank you. I want to give it a real answer, so I'll get back to you by {{reply_by}}.
If it becomes urgent before then, reply with "urgent" in the subject line and I'll see it sooner.

templates.name: Thank you after a conversation
templates.when: After a call, coffee, interview, or introduction.
templates.subject: Thank you, {{first_name}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for making time on {{day}}. I learned a lot from our conversation.
What stayed with me most was {{takeaway}}.
As promised, {{follow_through}}.
I'd like to stay in touch. If I can ever be useful to you, please ask.

templates.name: Introducing yourself
templates.when: Reaching out to someone you'd like to learn from or work with.
templates.subject: {{specific_reason}}
body: Hi {{first_name}},
I'm Htoo, a student at Tufts studying Cognitive and Brain Science and Computer Science, and co-founder of Briefly, a short-form podcast app.
I'm writing because {{why_them}}.
Would you be open to {{the_ask}}? I know your time is limited, so I'll keep it to {{time_needed}} and come prepared.
Either way, thank you for {{their_work}}.

templates.name: Away message
templates.when: Auto-reply during exams, travel, or a launch.
templates.subject: Away until {{return_date}}
body: Hi,
Thank you for your email. I'm away until {{return_date}} and replying more slowly than usual.
I'll answer after I'm back. For anything about Briefly that can't wait, please write to {{backup_contact}}.

templates.name: Contact form reply
templates.when: Sent by the site itself, right after someone uses the contact form.
templates.subject: Got your message
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for writing. This is an automatic note to confirm that your message reached me. I read every one myself and I'll reply personally, usually within a few days.
If you wrote about a project, these details help me give you a useful answer:

list: What you're building, and who it's for
Where it stands today (an idea, a prototype, or a live product)
When you'd like to start, and any deadline

body: You can reply to this email to add anything.

templates.name: Project inquiry reply
templates.when: Sent by the site itself, right after someone finishes the Start a project form on Services.
templates.subject: I received your project details
body: Hi {{first_name}},
Thank you for telling me about your project. This is an automatic note to confirm that your answers reached me. I'll read them myself and reply within a few days.
{{topic_line}}
Here is what happens next:

list: I read what you sent and note any questions.
I reply with first thoughts and a time for a short call.
After we talk, I send a scope and a price that fit the project.

body: If you have a deck, a link, or screenshots, reply to this email and attach them. They help.
